checklist.assertion: The joined boundary entity is exactly component_identity_candidate; this does not accept a component identity or reclassify the Event Media composition.
The versioned draft candidate states one bounded semantic role and explicit composition exclusions.
The draft candidate records explicit non-goals that prevent placements, semantic modes and adjacent product media from becoming the same identity.
Source and requirement evidence is present, but cell-level authority plus production-equivalent runtime binding remains open.
The candidate boundary is evidence-backed but remains unaccepted while the identity-set owner receipt is absent.
The draft candidate explicitly binds anatomy, slots, ownership and composition exclusions.
The draft candidate binds props, defaults, state axes, valid and invalid combinations, fixtures and extension limits.
Pinned source evidence and consumer refs bound the proposed implementation membership without authorizing a merge, split or migration.
The complete Event Media census includes each consumer referenced by the candidate; census completeness does not decide the identity boundary.
Every candidate consumer ref resolves to a census row with source, routes or an explicit source-only/lifecycle context.
The draft candidate has machine-readable state axes and required interaction or non-interaction behavior.
Consumer/container rules are drafted, but terminal responsive or production-equivalent evidence remains incomplete.
Accessibility requirements are explicit, but required future accessibility/browser tests and runtime reconciliation are not closed.
Current screenshots and controlled packets remain evidence only; none proves the required production-equivalent runtime reconciliation.
Typed Project Normalization findings and candidate-scoped Event Media blockers remain open.
The upstream identity-set owner decision is unresolved; empty evidence-blocker arrays cannot substitute for that decision.
The candidate is draft, non-accepted and has no owner review/decision receipt.
A reversible outline exists, but migration is not started or authorized and rollback evidence is planned only.
Every positive-readiness evidence reference is a pinned source or resolvable local catalog/contract identity.
Media policy applies, but consumer-scoped semantics, fit/crop/ratio or provenance closure remains incomplete.
Loading, layout reservation and missing/broken recovery are specified as draft requirements but lack complete tested closure.
No Event Media experiment exists in the pinned six-row registry; the candidate also preserves decision NOT_MERGED and no winner receipt.
No candidate-specific product-model dependency is asserted; the global observe/pending gate still forbids promotion.
